title: Long-running Agents
summary: Examines the engineering patterns for AI agents that persist across multiple sessions and sandboxes, including the Ralph loop, Anthropic's brain/hands/session architecture, Cursor's planner/worker/judge design, and Google's Agent Platform—all addressing finite context windows, persistent state management, and self-verification challenges.
when-to-read: Read this when designing or deploying AI agents that need to maintain progress across hours, days, or weeks rather than completing work in a single context window. If you're specifically focused on prompt engineering or individual agent reasoning within a single session, consult documentation on agentic reasoning patterns instead.
